hotels.description: Minutes from Leonardo da Vinci International Airport, this polished stay places you close to Fiumicino’s waterfront and the archaeological treasures of Ostia Antica. In nearby Isola Sacra, seafood trattorias line Via della Torre Clementina, where local menus feature just-caught fish, Roman pasta and harbour views. At the hotel, contemporary rooms are paired with a seasonal outdoor pool, a fitness area and an onsite restaurant serving Italian classics. Central Rome is within reach for visits to the Colosseum, Campo de’ Fiori and Trastevere’s cobbled lanes filled with enotecas and traditional osterias
